scope: Bounded source-caption, provenance and contact-sheet sanity QA; not specialist diagnostic certification.

curation.rules: Excluded nonmedical artwork/flags/ships/market figures, nonhuman studies, normal anatomy falsely matched through bibliography, ambiguous third-party textbook derivatives, wrong organs/entities/subtypes, and title-only contextual matches. Correct source panel descriptions retained for legitimate mixed research figures.

limits: Contact sheets were inspected as thumbnails, with source captions checked for suspicious matches; not every image was reviewed at diagnostic resolution.
No independent pathologist or medical educator has certified this collection or its disease labels. reviewed:false deliberately remains on source records.
Rights are grounded in individual Commons file metadata and recorded source evidence; public-domain/CC claims are not an independent legal opinion.
Research composites may include normal or other-disease panels; original captions identify the relevant panels and should remain visible.
Clinical diagnoses, magnifications and stains are source-reported, not independently verified.
Native explanatory SVG diagrams are maintained separately; Commons-only gaps do not by themselves imply total atlas gaps.
